analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($60.32) vs SMA5/20/50 ($63.58/$66.76/$68.91): below short/mid-term trend.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($68.91/$64.79): indicates weak mid/long-term trend.
· 52-week position (48.4%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.4→31.0): confirmed entry into oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0811→-0.5787): continued worsening, diagnosed as bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at $61.15): interpreted as approaching the lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($57.54): based on Pivot S1 ($56.75) and 200-day SMA ($64.79).
· Swing resistance ($60.37): lower than 5-day high ($68.11) and 20-day high ($70.94).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low, No Lower High): diagnosed as a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.55x vs 5-day average): adds conviction to the move, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): short-term bounce attempts present but trend reversal unconfirmed, maintaining a wait-and-see condition.
